raw.query: SELECT resolution, ROUND(AVG(((c.mae_cov-u.mae_uni)/u.mae_uni*100))::numeric,4) AS mean_over_4_signals_pct FROM (SELECT resolution,variate,mae AS mae_cov FROM forecast_metrics WHERE model='toto' AND mode='cov' AND h=-1 AND span='common' AND candidate='point') c JOIN (SELECT resolution,variate,mae AS mae_uni FROM forecast_metrics WHERE model='toto' AND mode='uni' AND h=-1 AND span='common' AND candidate='point') u ON c.resolution=u.resolution AND c.variate=u.variate GROUP BY resolution ORDER BY CASE resolution WHEN '1min' THEN 1 WHEN '45s' THEN 2 WHEN '30s' THEN 3 WHEN '15s' THEN 4 WHEN '1s' THEN 5 END
raw.evidence: All five DB-computed mean-over-4-signals relative point MAE changes (h=-1, span=common, candidate=point) match the claimed percentages to the stated precision after rounding.
